source_system: arXiv primary abstracts and AIAC news17 field catalog
guardrails: These are exploratory hypotheses, not reproduced paper signals or validated Alphas.
The news17 recurrence field is not the paper's press-release/call-text novelty measure.
Use D1 News fields only; do not use post-event prices or predicted impact as input.
Compare the novelty interaction to a sentiment-only control under identical simulation settings.

families.paper_title: Measuring What is Repeated and Novel in Earnings Disclosures Using Optimal Transport
families.economic_mechanism: The paper separates repeated from novel earnings-disclosure text. As a transfer experiment, test whether the sentiment effect differs when a similar event was seen less recently. news17 event_similarity_days measures recurrence timing only and cannot reproduce paired-text novelty.
families.expected_direction: Sentiment times longer time since a similar event may outperform a sentiment-only control; the interaction sign is exploratory.
falsification_conditions: Under matched WQ settings, the recurrence-conditioned signal does not improve over the sentiment-only control.
The interaction's sign or quality changes materially across adjacent windows or coverage strata.
families.mapping_limitations: The paper compares press releases and earnings-call text using optimal transport. AIAC has neither paired texts nor this novelty score; event_similarity_days is a weaker, non-equivalent proxy.
families.migration_note: WQ-compatible proxy experiment only. Do not claim reproduction of the paper's return result.

families.paper_title: Evaluating Financial Sentiment in the Age of AI
families.economic_mechanism: Sentiment measures can track earnings-surprise information without producing a next-day return signal. Use raw event sentiment as a matched control, not as a claimed alpha.
families.expected_direction: No positive next-day return effect is assumed; the control establishes whether recurrence conditioning adds value.
falsification_conditions: The comparison is invalid if control and interaction use different WQ settings or data coverage.
A result cannot be credited to novelty if the conditioned expression performs no better than this control.
families.mapping_limitations: The paper evaluates text-derived sentiment metrics; AIAC news17 supplies a vendor event-sentiment score, so this is an analogous control rather than its exact measure.
families.migration_note: Null/control family, not a validated predictive signal.
